description: Who changed what on the brand’s AppLovin campaigns, and when: creation, edits (field by field, before and after), status changes and ARCHIVING — including archived campaigns that list_applovin_ads_campaigns no longer returns. One campaign (campaignId) or the whole account; since/until must fall within the latest 30 UTC days and go together (neither = the last 7 days). Read-only, free. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.

campaignId.description: ONE campaign id; omit for every campaign

title: AppLovin campaign change history
